An energizer adapted from
Power Up for Learning! Physical Activity Supplement
"Let-us" Conga!

Let-us get started!
Form a conga line with your table mates
Place your hands on the shoulders of the person in front of you
When the name of a fruit/veggie is called:
Reach “high” if the f/v grows high
Reach to the “side” for medium growing f/v
Squat “low” for low growing f/v
READY??

We hope you enjoyed the physical activity break.
Try to incorporate at        least 60 minutes of PA     into every day!
"Let-us" Conga!
